analysis:
Why it may be cheap—or why it is not

The saved run does not establish cheapness or a margin of safety: price, value range and valid comparable owner cash flow are unavailable. Verified annual operating cash consumption warrants caution, but is not a substitute for normalized owner cash flow or proof of overvaluation. Inherited obligations, insider code-P purchases, trading liquidity and forced selling are not established by the supplied evidence.

The next filing must establish reported-after-spin owner cash flow on a comparable basis. A sign change relative to current normalized owner cash flow would change the view, but the worksheet lacks that baseline, so this trigger cannot yet be evaluated.
